description: Look up harvest yield and wine quality across vintages for a block. Shows brix, yield, quality score per year.

configuration.query: FROM vineyard-harvest | WHERE block_id == ?block_id | STATS avg_brix = AVG(sugar_brix), total_kg = SUM(grape_mass_kg), avg_quality = AVG(quality_score) BY vintage_year | SORT vintage_year ASC
